ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from manually updating system-controlled statuses such as Ongoing, Referred, Approval Pending, and Completed. These statuses are updated automatically via system logic.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Completed") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Ongoing"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Referred"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approval Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Diagnosis Approved") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot manually change this status. It is automatically updated by the system.
